annotations.title: Where you can actually play, courts, fields, greens and tonight's pickup run

description: Where to play a sport on the East End, 75 verified venues: public and club courts, school fields, golf, beach volleyball, surf breaks, mountain-bike and trail-running routes, the skate park, the disc golf course, sailing, riding stables, and 7 recurring basketball pickup runs. `access` says who gets on: 12 of these are `members-only`, including Maidstone Club; Shinnecock Hills Golf Club; Topping Riding Club; The Meadow Club of Southampton, Paddle Tennis; Breakwater Yacht Club, Sailing; Montauk Downs, a state park anyone can book, is in the same list. `access: permit` means play is free and the parking needs a beach permit (Ditch Plains, Indian Wells, Main Beach). `access: not-published` means the record shows open play and the guide holds no rate. `access` is a tag with no figure behind it; the only rates returned are those written into `notes`, the operator's published figures as an editor read them. `notes` also records the guide's own doubt where a court or surf claim is unconfirmed local knowledge rather than something the operator publishes. `checkedAndNotThere` lists sports the guide looked for an operator for and found none: padel, badminton, boxing and ice skating have no verified East End venue, and two announced pickleball courts are unbuilt or unsourced. `pickup` gives each basketball run's day and time with `runsToday`, `startsAt`/`endsAt` and `alreadyOverToday` computed on the East End's clock (America/New_York), and flags `openCourt` for outdoor courts published as daily dawn-to-dusk. The `access` argument filters to one access kind; rows that fail the filter come back in `ruledOut` with the reason. With no argument nothing is looked up and the answer lists the sports and towns covered. Returns up to 8. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

access.description: 'walk-on' = a visitor can turn up and play (excludes the clubs, the leagues and the lessons-only); 'free' = the guide records no charge to play.

sport.description: The sport, in the asker's own words: 'pickleball', 'hoops', 'paddle', 'surfing', 'disc golf', 'trail running'. A venue name ('Shinnecock', 'Montauk Downs', 'skate park') also resolves.

town.description: A hamlet ('Montauk', 'Sag Harbor') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'East End'), in the asker's own words.
